caption: Fira Caldera Rim, Santorini
composition: Caldera-rim town stepping to the old port · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Fira rim walk, looking west, white and cream houses step down the volcanic cliff toward a small old port. Dark islets sit in the caldera. The sky is clear, about 18.2°C, with wind near 21 km/h. The sun is low in the east, so the seaward walls are in cool morning shade. This is Fira, not the Oia viewpoint of GR-01-003.
